implementation: RapidIdentity FIPS Cryptographic Module for Mobile
description: The RapidIdentity FIPS Cryptographic Module for Mobile is a cryptographic engine for mobile devices used by the RapidIdentity mobile application, providing PingMe and OTP authentication. The module leverages FIPS-approved cryptographic algorithms provided by the Bouncy Castle FIPS .NET and Java APIs.
